span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Clinical neglect of the single neuron is explained by the prior unavailability of technology able to target or measure small groups of neurons
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Propofol produces unconsciousness by phase-locking cortical neurons to local slow oscillations that are out of phase across regions, fragmenting long-range cortical communication
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Loss of dopamine erodes the separation normally maintained between basal ganglia subcircuits, so circuit elements merge into larger hypersynchronised networks that drive motor cortical synchrony
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the absence is attributed to instrument resolution: MRI, EEG and MEG cannot resolve activity at the scale of the action potential

span.label: Despite being foundational to brain function, single-neuron activity has almost no presence in everyday clinical neurology, neurosurgery or psychiatry.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The dominant clinical measurement modalities cannot resolve activity at the scale of the action potential, which the review identifies as the core gap.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Even after four decades of relevant recordings, single-unit physiology remains a marginal component of neurological and psychiatric practice.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Microelectrode and macroelectrode array work has undermined the standard account of epilepsy as purely a disorder of hypersynchrony and excitation-inhibition imbalance.
